samples.xml_description:
<module id="parallel2serial">
    <description>Implement a parallel to serial converter with MSB to LSB order.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="d" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit parallel data input.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Valid signal for serial output.</output>
        <output id="dout">Serial data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="s0">0</parameter>
        <parameter id="s1">1</parameter>
        <parameter id="s2">2</parameter>
        <parameter id="s3">3</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <line>assign dout = data[3];</line>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <line>always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin</line>
        <line>    if (!rst_n) begin</line>
        <line>        cnt <= 0;</line>
        <line>    end</line>
        <line>    else begin</line>
        <line>        if (cnt == 3) begin</line>
        <line>            data <= d;</line>
        <line>            cnt <= 0;</line>
        <line>            valid <= 1;</line>
        <line>        end</line>
        <line>        else begin</line>
        <line>            cnt <= cnt + 1;</line>
        <line>            valid <= 0;</line>
        <line>            data <= {data[2:0], data[3]}</line>
        <line>        end</line>
        <line>    end</line>
        <line>end</line>
    </implementation>
</module>
